parts.text:
A single die-cut sticker icon from a cute, cohesive sticker set: one chunky, rounded, simplified cartoon object drawn as a clean flat illustration.
The object is a straight ruler with tick marks. Draw it as one chunky, rounded, simplified object with friendly, slightly squashed proportions, big simple shapes and only the few details needed to recognise it at a glance, even when the sticker is shown very small. Exactly one single straight ruler lying diagonally (not two crossed rulers), with tick marks only and no numbers.
The sticker lies alone on a perfectly flat, uniform chroma-key green background (#00FF00) that fills the whole square edge to edge: one solid colour with no gradient, texture, vignette, shadow, floor, reflection or scenery.

Framing: the whole sticker, white border included, is centred in the square and fills about 75% of the frame, with an even chroma-key green margin on every side. Square 1:1.
